title: He spends up to $6M a month on Meta ads — and this is his secret 👀 I ...
description: He spends up to $6M a month on Meta ads — and this is his secret 👀 I asked this guy how much he spends on Meta ads. He said: “Between four and six million a month.” 😳 Then he dropped a gem every advertiser should hear: “It’s not rocket science. Keep it simple.” One testing campaign. One top-of-funnel ASC with your best ads. One bottom-funnel ASC for promos and retargeting. And here’s the hack that blew my mind — “Run your winning ads across multiple FB & IG pages.” That’s how he multiplies reach and avoids fatigue like a pro. Would you test it if you knew it could double your results? 👇 Comment “SCALE” if you want to apply to work with me 1:1 and learn how to build systems that actually scale. 🚀
transcript: Hey man, so what's your name? Matt. Where are you from? I work at JaviCon. How much are you guys spending right now? Four to six million a month. Nice! And what's something you're looking forward to? One of the big things I'm looking forward to is seeing some of the new AI tactics. Oh yeah. You got like a 10 second tip you could share? I think the most important thing is creatives. The funnel itself going from advertorial to sales page checkout. Nice. And the account structure. Okay, what kind of account structure do you like? You know, it's not rocket science. Keep it really simple. We just have an ABO that we do our testing and we scale in place. We have a top of funnel ASC campaign with only the best of best ads. And then we have a bottom of funnel retargeting promos ASC. I think one of my biggest hacks that I would love to share. Please, please share. Is creating different Facebook pages and Instagram accounts. Okay. So whenever I find a winning ad, I do my ad across all those different pages. Okay. You're just mutating and spreading like a wildfire, you know? I love that man. That's a great tip man. Thank you so much. I appreciate it.
